extension.summary: Show a MyPicsDB 3 collection as a Kodi screensaver
extension.description: Displays still pictures from one saved smart collection or manual MyPicsDB 3 collection. The screensaver is read-only, performs no scans and uses a bounded database query.
extension.disclaimer: Select a collection explicitly in the screensaver settings. No all-library or geotagged source is selected automatically.
extension.news: Initial MyPicsDB-aware screensaver with explicit manual/smart collection selection, bounded read-only queries and graceful database/source fallback.
